title: Shingle Repair in Estacada, OR
summary: In October 2026, French Roofing repaired a few lifted shingles near the vents on a home in Estacada, OR. The damaged shingles came out and new underlayment went down before the new shingles, so the repair covers every layer, not just the top one.
scope: Removed the damaged shingles near the vents
New shingles over the repaired area
